caption: The video captures a dancer practicing in a studio lined with a full mirrored wall, wooden ballet barres, a string of small ceiling lights, and a floor fan against pale blue walls. She wears a pink mask, a sleeveless black dress with a high side slit, and pointe-style shoes, with a small tattoo visible on her lower leg. A folded orange fan is held against her torso by one hand throughout the clip. The figure at the right is her own reflection, not a second person. Her free arm, starting bent near the hip, gradually sweeps outward and backward, lifting diagonally up and over her head to remain extended high. As the arm travels, her torso arches and leans back, her head tilting upward. Her feet remain flat on the floor throughout the sequence. The crossed legs and dress hem shift subtly with the lean.
